author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: The Fed's November 1 hold, softer ADP and ISM data and a bull-steepening Treasury curve mark a pause in the rate shock, which favours intermediate duration, quality growth, AI semis, utilities and post-election Poland. Growth outside the US is rolling over (euro-area GDP dip, China's October PMI relapse, falling oil), so China-linked cyclicals, European autos and energy stay underweight while heavier Treasury supply is the main risk to the duration call.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-02 frozen own-date headlines (cited inline) and the 2023-11-02 market card; each instrument uses its own completed session (US/Europe/Asia 2023-11-01, Warsaw 2023-10-31 because of the November 1 holiday, crypto prior completed UTC daily close 2023-11-01). After-close company reports of 2023-11-01 (Qualcomm, PayPal, DoorDash, e.l.f.) are treated as released before the cutoff; no 2023-11-02 session move or later event is used. No numeric spot-FX levels or returns.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n1596 (Reuters, yen sinks as BOJ policy adjustment seen inadequate): indexed 2023-10-30 although it reports the BOJ decision of 2023-10-31; misdated record, not cited, so the BOJ's October 31 adjustment itself is not described.

n0988/n0989 (SolarEdge shares plunge on weak Q4 guidance): the plunge appears to be extended trading after the 2023-11-01 session, which closed only -0.21% on the card; omitted to avoid conflating sessions.
n0951 (JFrog stock jumps on earnings): unclear whether the move refers to 2023-11-01 extended trading or the 2023-11-02 session; omitted.
n1647 (Ukraine note to Poland on border blocking): timing relative to the Polish hauliers' blockade is unclear from the headline; omitted.
n1611 and n1617 carry numeric yen quotes in their titles; n1611 is cited only for the absence of intervention and no FX number is reproduced.
n1658 (RPP meeting preview, 2023-10-03) is a superseded preview and is not used to state any NBP rate decision; no own-date headline gives the current NBP rate level.

Headlines whose titles carry later-year content and look misdated or refreshed pages: n2042 (US CPI 2026 calendar), n2090 (ADP review 2026), n1786 (IKZE rules in 2026), n1238 (Uber Eats driver income [2026]), n1118 (Finolex Q1 results 2026), n0709 (pickles market 2025-2034).
